title: Evolve shared understanding gradually; the three lines are a universal lens every domain carries (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Let's not scrap anything based on this comment. We gradually evolve shared understanding. (Dream time should be watching for these and testing) 

The three lines of the trigram still do the work. They are a lens. And your suggestion that we carry the function not the content is the synethetic way. We are defining universally applicable patterns of change. We have established our base poles and these get carried through all domains. They just get refined and renamed but the lens is universal.

Every domain must have energy in a direction. In or out. 

Every domain must have a direction of change - disruption or stability 

Every domain must choose how it manages it's boundary: open or closed
